description: This is a Java interface defining the contract for client write operations such as creating, updating, activating, deleting, and other client-related actions within the Fineract application.

classes.name: ClientWritePlatformService
classes.description: This interface defines multiple methods for performing write operations related to client management.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates an existing client identified by clientId with details provided in the JsonCommand.

methods.name: activateClient
methods.description: Activates a client account identified by clientId.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes the client identified by clientId.

methods.name: unassignClientStaff
methods.description: Unassigns staff from the client identified by clientId.

methods.name: closeClient
methods.description: Closes the client account identified by clientId.

methods.name: assignClientStaff
methods.description: Assigns staff to the client identified by clientId.

methods.name: updateDefaultSavingsAccount
methods.description: Updates the default savings account for the client.

methods.name: rejectClient
methods.description: Rejects a client based on the provided entityId.

methods.name: withdrawClient
methods.description: Processes withdrawal for the client identified by entityId.

methods.name: reActivateClient
methods.description: Reactivates a previously closed or rejected client.

methods.name: undoWithdrawal
methods.description: Undoes a withdrawal action for the client.
